description: This file contains a PHP trait 'EncryptionTraitV2' that provides methods related to encryption, including building encryption streams, handling cipher options, and generating encryption metadata for AWS SDK integrations. It is part of the AWS SDK's cryptographic functionalities.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to generate a cipher method object based on cipher name, IV, and key size.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Performs encryption on a plaintext stream, generates encryption metadata, and populates an envelope object with encryption details.

methods.name: getEncryptingStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a stream that encrypts plaintext data using the specified cipher options.
